question: Estimate the annual revenue from in-app purchases in mobile games in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: IAP only — exclude ad revenue, subscriptions to gaming services? Yes.
BGMI + Free Fire + Clash + indie games combined? Yes — all mobile.
Include only Indian players (paying in INR)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Bottom-up: gamer base × paying conversion × ARPPU (avg revenue per paying user).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Mobile gamers in India (any game, monthly): ~500M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Conversion rate to paying (low — Indian users are price-sensitive): ~4-5% = 11M.
